        NULLIF(COUNT(DISTINCT CASE WHEN dd.player_out_id = p.player_id THEN dd.match_id || '-' || dd.inning END), 0) AS batting_average

WHERE d.batting_team != 'Australia' 
  AND d.bowling_team = 'Australia'
GROUP BY p.player_id, p.player_name
ORDER BY batting_average DESC
LIMIT 1;

SELECT 
    team,
    SUM(CASE WHEN result = 'win' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) * 1.0 / COUNT(*) * 100.0 AS win_percentage
FROM (
    SELECT 
        team1 AS team,
        CASE WHEN match_winner = team1 THEN 'win' ELSE 'loss' END AS result
    FROM Matches
    WHERE match_winner IS NOT NULL
    UNION ALL
    SELECT 
        team2 AS team,
        CASE WHEN match_winner = team2 THEN 'win' ELSE 'loss' END AS result
    FROM Matches
    WHERE match_winner IS NOT NULL
)
GROUP BY team
ORDER BY win_percentage

JOIN Players p ON d.striker_id = p.player_id
JOIN Matches m ON d.match_id = m.match_id
WHERE d.batting_team = 'India'
  AND m.season LIKE '%World Cup%'
GROUP BY d.match_id, d.inning, d.striker_id
ORDER BY individual_score DESC
LIMIT 1
